description:
Conduct a thorough research on ^GSPC. Your analysis should include:
 1. Current stock price and historical performance (5 years).
 2. Key financial metrics (P/E, EPS growth, revenue growth, margins).
 3. Recent news and press releases (1 month).
 4. Analyst ratings and price targets (min 3 analysts).
 5. Reddit sentiment analysis (100 posts).
 6. Major institutional holders and recent changes.
 7. Competitive landscape and ^GSPC's market share.
 Use reputable financial websites for data.
name: research_task
expected_output: A detailed 200-word research report with data sources and brief analysis.

json_dict.researchreport: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is currently trading around $5,282.70 (Motley Fool, April 17, 2025). Over the past 5 years, it has delivered an average annual return of 16.5% (UpMyInterest). The current P/E ratio is 27.99 (YCharts). Earnings growth is projected at 7.2%, 9.7%, and 9.3% for Q2-Q4 2025, respectively (FactSet). 4Q24 saw blended sales growth of +4.2% y/y and a pro-forma net margin of 13.5% (DWS Group). Recent news includes S&P 500 Q4 2024 buybacks increasing 7.4% (Yahoo Finance) and TotalEnergies supplying GSPC with LNG (TotalEnergies). Analyst ratings for 2025 vary, with some firms projecting the S&P 500 to end the year between 6,400 and 7,100, while others have widened their forecasts to a range of 5,200 to 7,000 (Morningstar). Carson Group predicts a 12% to 15% rise in 2025 (Yahoo Finance). Citi Research has a year-end 2025 target of 6,500, based on $270 EPS (Barron's). Goldman Sachs forecasts the S&P 500 to reach 6,500 by the end of 2025, representing a 10% total return (Goldman Sachs).
